title: 13 Best Herbal Creams For High Blood Pressure
intro: Herbal creams for high blood pressure are topical creams or ointments made from natural herbs and plants that are used to treat and manage hypertension. These creams work by reducing blood pressure through various mechanisms such as relaxing blood vessels, reducing inflammation, and improving circulation. Examples of herbal creams that can be used to treat high blood pressure include Passionflower cream, which helps to calm the nervous system and reduce anxiety, and Hawthorn cream, which improves heart function and reduces blood pressure. Other examples include Valerian root cream, which promotes relaxation and reduces stress, and Ginger cream, which reduces inflammation and improves circulation, making them effective alternatives to traditional medications.

preparations.preparation_desc: Ginkgo biloba creams have been gaining attention for their potential in treating high blood pressure due to their unique blend of flavonoids, terpenoids, and bilobalide, which work in synergy to promote vascular health and reduce blood pressure. The bioactive constituents of Ginkgo biloba creams, including quercetin and kaempferol, help to relax blood vessels, improve blood flow, and inhibit platelet aggregation, thereby contributing to the reduction of blood pressure. The benefits of Ginkgo biloba creams in treating high blood pressure include improved cardiovascular function, reduced risk of cardiovascular disease, and enhanced overall well-being. Regular use of Ginkgo biloba creams may also help to alleviate symptoms of high blood pressure, such as dizziness and headaches, and promote a healthier lifestyle.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "International journal of clinical pharmacology, therapy, and toxicology", Ginkgo biloba creams for high blood pressure may help in decreasing systolic blood pressure, especially with high-dose administration, and reducing spontaneous platelet aggregation.

preparations.preparation_desc: Valeriana officinalis creams, derived from the root of the valerian plant, have been used to treat high blood pressure due to their sedative and calming properties, which help to reduce stress and anxiety levels. The bioactive constituents present in this herbal preparation, including valepotriates and isovaleramate, have been found to contribute to its efficacy in lowering blood pressure by promoting relaxation and reducing the heart rate. By reducing stress and promoting relaxation, Valeriana officinalis creams help to alleviate symptoms of high blood pressure, such as headaches and dizziness, and can also help to reduce the risk of cardiovascular disease. The benefits of using Valeriana officinalis creams to treat high blood pressure include reduced reliance on pharmaceutical medications, improved sleep quality, and a lower risk of adverse side effects associated with conventional treatments.

This herbal preparation helps to treat high blood pressure by dilating blood vessels, thereby improving blood flow and reducing the pressure on the cardiovascular system. The bioactive constituents of Lavandula angustifolia creams, including linalool and linalyl acetate, have been found to have a positive effect on cardiovascular health by reducing inflammation and improving blood vessel function. The benefits of using Lavandula angustifolia creams to treat high blood pressure include reduced risk of cardiovascular disease, improved sleep quality, and a decrease in anxiety and stress levels.

Zingiber officinale creams have been traditionally used to treat high blood pressure due to their vasodilatory properties, which help to relax blood vessels and improve blood flow. The bioactive constituents of Zingiber officinale, including gingerols and shogaols, have been shown to inhibit the activity of angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE), a key regulator of blood pressure. By inhibiting ACE, Zingiber officinale creams help to reduce blood pressure and alleviate symptoms associated with hypertension. The benefits of using Zingiber officinale creams to treat high blood pressure include reduced risk of cardiovascular disease, improved circulation, and a decrease in the need for medication.
preparations.preparation_study: According to the scientific study, Zingiber officinale creams for high blood pressure may be effective due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, as it was found to significantly decrease blood pressure in Wister rats when administered orally for 28 days.

preparations.preparation_desc: Panax ginseng creams have been studied for their potential to treat high blood pressure, a condition characterized by elevated blood pressure that can lead to cardiovascular disease. This herbal preparation is rich in bioactive constituents such as ginsenosides, which are believed to help lower blood pressure by promoting vasodilation and reducing vascular resistance. The benefits of Panax ginseng creams in treating high blood pressure include improved cardiovascular function, reduced risk of hypertension-related complications, and enhanced overall well-being. By incorporating Panax ginseng creams into their daily regimen, individuals may be able to effectively manage their high blood pressure and reduce their risk of associated health problems.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "American journal of health-system pharmacy : AJHP : official journal of the American Society of Health-System Pharmacists", Panax ginseng creams for high blood pressure are potentially safe, as they are mentioned among the list of herbs that have been identified as potentially safe, including Asian ginseng.

preparations.preparation_desc: Rosmarinus officinalis creams, derived from the herb rosemary, have been traditionally used to treat high blood pressure due to their vasodilatory properties that help to relax blood vessels and improve blood flow. Glycyrrhiza glabra creams, derived from the root of the licorice plant, have been traditionally used to treat high blood pressure due to their potent properties that help to relax blood vessels and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents present in these creams, including glycyrrhizin and flavonoids, exhibit vasodilatory and antioxidant effects that contribute to their therapeutic benefits. By inhibiting the activity of the enzyme 11-beta-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase, glycyrrhizin helps to reduce the levels of aldosterone, a hormone that can contribute to high blood pressure. The regular use of Glycyrrhiza glabra creams may lead to improved cardiovascular health, reduced blood pressure, and a lower risk of related complications, making them a promising natural remedy for the management of high blood pressure.

Curcuma longa creams, derived from the turmeric plant, have been traditionally used to treat high blood pressure due to their potent vasodilatory, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Curcuma longa creams, including curcumin, demethoxycurcumin, and bisdemethoxycurcumin, help to reduce blood pressure by inhibiting the angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) and promoting the relaxation of blood vessels. These creams help to treat high blood pressure by improving cardiovascular health, reducing oxidative stress, and enhancing the body's natural ability to regulate blood pressure. The benefits of using Curcuma longa creams to treat high blood pressure include improved overall cardiovascular health, reduced risk of heart disease, and a natural, non-pharmacological approach to managing blood pressure.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Journal of complementary & integrative medicine", Curcuma longa creams for high blood pressure have been found to have an antihypertensive effect, causing a decline in elevated blood pressure of hypertensive rats and reversing derangements in haemogram and urinalysis associated with hypertension.

preparations.preparation_desc: Centella asiatica creams have gained popularity as a natural remedy to treat high blood pressure due to their unique properties that help to relax blood vessels and improve cardiovascular health. The active compounds present in these creams, such as triterpenoids and saponins, have been found to have vasodilatory effects, reducing blood pressure and improving overall cardiovascular function. By increasing nitric oxide production and reducing inflammation, Centella asiatica creams help to improve blood flow and lower blood pressure, providing relief from hypertension symptoms. Regular use of these creams has been associated with benefits such as reduced blood pressure, improved circulation, and enhanced overall cardiovascular health, making them a valuable addition to a natural hypertension treatment plan.

Rauvolfia serpentina creams, also known as Indian snakeroot, are herbal preparations used to treat high blood pressure due to their vasodilatory properties that help to relax the blood vessels and reduce blood pressure. The bioactive constituents, including reserpine and ajmaline, in Rauvolfia serpentina creams help to inhibit the reabsorption of catecholamines, thereby reducing sympathetic nerve activity and lowering blood pressure. This herbal preparation helps to treat high blood pressure by reducing peripheral resistance, cardiac output, and myocardial contractility, ultimately leading to a decrease in blood pressure. The benefits of using Rauvolfia serpentina creams for treating high blood pressure include reduced risk of cardiovascular complications, improved quality of life, and a natural alternative to conventional antihypertensive medications.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Natural products and bioprospecting", Rauvolfia serpentina creams for high blood pressure are mentioned among the herbal medicines used for the management and treatment of hypertension with minimum side effects.

The silymarin in Silybum marianum creams helps to scavenge free radicals, reduce lipid peroxidation, and inhibit the activity of angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE), ultimately leading to a decrease in blood pressure. Regular use of Silybum marianum creams may help to reduce the risk of cardiovascular events and improve overall cardiovascular health in individuals with high blood pressure.
